trigger: Alert level >= 8 or class A/B rule family
retry_behavior: 3 attempts with backoff, then local log file
failure_mode: IRIS down: alert logged locally; replay from OpenSearch archive
test_event: POST payload-contracts/wazuh-high-severity.json to Shuffle webhook; expect IRIS alert
data_retention: IRIS per retention policy; OpenSearch wazuh-alerts-* per cluster retention
